figures.caption: Fig. 3: Overview of S2ED. The Narrative Segmenter produces frame-level captions, the Consistency Grounder extracts character and appearance attributes from the caption and global knowledge bases, and the Visual Enricher integrates layout and affect cues to produce Executable Descriptions for T2I rendering.

Fig. 4: Qualitative overview of S2ED. Top: Results on the Flintstones dataset comparing S2ED with prompting baselines (Plain, TokenInject, Layout) and StoryDiffusion across multiple frames (1, 5, 10, 11). Bottom: Results on the Shakoo Maku dataset showing end-to-end story-to-image generation (Frames 1–4), comparing GPT-5, Gemini-2.5 Pro, and S2ED.
